blocks.x: Problem statement: Indian FASTag users need a clear, reliable way to know whether their vehicle is toll-ready, understand every deduction, resolve wrong deductions, and choose the right pass or recharge option before travel. Today the user experience is fragmented across issuer banks, toll plazas, NHAI/IHMCL portals, annual pass flows, and dispute channels.

Make toll crossing predictable, explainable, and low-friction for Indian vehicle owners and fleets.
FASTag users with recurring toll usage, private vehicles eligible for annual pass, SME fleets, and toll operators managing high exception volume.
Build the trusted control layer above fragmented issuer and plaza systems: one vehicle identity, health check, event ledger, disputes, pass optimization, and exception intelligence.
1) FASTag health diagnosis. 2) Explainable toll ledger. 3) Dispute workflow and refund tracker. 4) Pass and route optimizer. 5) Fleet and operator views.
No new wallet in MVP. No nationwide GNSS replacement. No fully autonomous penalty, blacklist, or refund rejection. No loyalty or gamification.

blocks.x: By the end of the MVP pilot, users should be able to confirm toll readiness, understand all recent deductions, raise a dispute in under 60 seconds, and see pass/recharge recommendations before travel.
North Star: successful toll crossings without user intervention. This means the vehicle crosses, the correct amount or pass entitlement is applied, and no manual complaint is required.
